import MumfordLib.FundamentalGroupEquivalence

/-!
# Straight period loops in a lattice quotient

Every period gives a canonical based loop in the quotient: project the straight
segment from the origin to that period.  This is the concrete producer used to
compute the lifted-endpoint fundamental-group equivalence.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford
namespace Uniformization

open ComplexVectorLatticeExponentialData

variable {V X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℂ V]
  [AddCommGroup X] [TopologicalSpace X] {g : ℕ}
  (d : ComplexVectorLatticeExponentialData V X g)

/-- The straight segment from `0` to a period, projected to the quotient. -/
def quotientPeriodLoopPath (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) :
    Path (0 : V ⧸ d.ambientPeriodLattice) 0 :=
  let Γ : Path (0 : V) (u : V) :=
    { toFun := fun t => (t : ℝ) • (u : V)
      source' := by simp
      target' := by simp }
  { toFun := fun t => QuotientAddGroup.mk'
        d.ambientPeriodLattice (Γ t)
    continuous_toFun := QuotientAddGroup.continuous_mk.comp Γ.continuous
    source' := by simp
    target' := by
      simp [Γ, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff, u.property] }

@[simp]
theorem quotientPeriodLoopPath_apply (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) (t : unitInterval) :
    quotientPeriodLoopPath d u t =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' d.ambientPeriodLattice ((t : ℝ) • (u : V)) := by
  rfl

/-- The homotopy class of the straight period loop. -/
def quotientPeriodLoop (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) :
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient
      (0 : V ⧸ d.ambientPeriodLattice) 0 :=
  Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (quotientPeriodLoopPath d u)

theorem quotientPeriodLoop_monodromy (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) :
    (d.quotient_mk_isCoveringMap.monodromy (quotientPeriodLoop d u)
      ⟨0, by simp⟩).1 = u := by
  let Γ : Path (0 : V) (u : V) :=
    { toFun := fun t => (t : ℝ) • (u : V)
      source' := by simp
      target' := by simp }
  let γ := quotientPeriodLoopPath d u
  let hstart : (γ : C(unitInterval, V ⧸ d.ambientPeriodLattice)) 0 = 0 := by
    simp [γ]
  change (d.quotient_mk_isCoveringMap.monodromy
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ) ⟨0, by simp⟩).1 = u
  change (d.quotient_mk_isCoveringMap.liftPath
      (γ : C(unitInterval, V ⧸ d.ambientPeriodLattice)) 0 hstart 1) = u
  have hproj : (fun v : V => QuotientAddGroup.mk'
      d.ambientPeriodLattice v) ∘ Γ.toContinuousMap = γ.toContinuousMap := by
    ext t
    rfl
  have hlift := (d.quotient_mk_isCoveringMap.eq_liftPath_iff'
      hstart).mpr ⟨hproj, by simp [Γ]⟩
  rw [← hlift]
  simp [Γ]

@[simp]
theorem quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_quotientPeriodLoop
    (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) :
    ((quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv d (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
      (quotientPeriodLoop d u))).toAdd : V) = u := by
  rw [quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_apply]
  exact quotientPeriodLoop_monodromy d u

@[simp]
theorem quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_apply_periodLoop
    (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) :
    quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv d (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
      (quotientPeriodLoop d u)) = Multiplicative.ofAdd u := by
  apply congr_arg Multiplicative.ofAdd
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_quotientPeriodLoop d u

end Uniformization
end Mumford
